title: Scientific AI, optional web search and evidence use

definitions.wholeTaskPass: The saved official whole-task pass outcome. Scientific misses, tool/format failures and resource/provider outcomes remain distinct in the public per-setting records.
definitions.validFinal: The saved official parse-valid final answer, independently of whether its scientific fields pass.
definitions.sharedFieldComparison: Only identical fields officially graded in both specified conditions; ungraded fields are absent from each intersection, so denominators differ.
definitions.issuedSearch: A model-issued search request, whether executed or not.
definitions.executedSearch: A request accepted and handled by the search broker.
definitions.physicalSearch: A verified physical client request to the backend; a helper response can contain multiple built-in search actions.
definitions.boundedFetchText: A complete HTTP200 guarded publisher fetch with delivered nonempty text; this does not prove the full methods were read.
definitions.excerptRecord: A delivered Exa highlight record. The Luna equivalent is unmeasured and is null, not zero.
definitions.cost: Recorded estimates and unresolved bounds, not invoices. Local Nemo hardware cost is unpriced. Failed-request allowances are not verified failed-response token usage.

qualifications: Descriptive historical reruns, not randomized causal backend or prompting ablations.
The original no-web condition had narrower serving-context allowances and includes resource-censored outcomes.

Exa combines34v1+2v2+54v3 owners; the later56 share a bounded42-query methods catalog and the final54 used up to five Muse workers. Guard, scheduling, time, provider and retrieval differences remain confounded.
Models chose whether to use search. Searched versus unsearched settings are selected subsets, not randomized groups.
One observation per profile/task per condition; tasks recur across profiles. No population ranking or training-membership claim.

A public trace audit reviewed all90 tool inventories, all seven distinct gains, all four searched passes and three representative searched misses; the other nine searched misses had inventory review only.
No private reasoning, benchmark answers, raw transcripts, receipt archives, secrets or local file paths are included in this public export.

definitions.population: 260 paired completed profile/task settings across five saved model families, 26 profile strata and 10 tasks. The profile strata are not repeat trials.
definitions.wholeTaskPass: Saved reviewed whole-task category equals pass; scientific misses, tool/format, provider, harness, output and context outcomes are retained separately.
definitions.route: Original and web route labels were checked against the saved metadata for all 260 pairs. API and native-product routes are separate strata.
definitions.contextWindow: Saved applied context-window metadata, not a count of tokens generated or proof of equal compute. Native products may involve additional product/child contexts. Null or absent native-window observations are not assumed equal.
definitions.servingWindowChanged: Saved flag for a change in the applied serving-window metadata between the paired original and web runs.
definitions.profileOrder: Fixed saved source model order and source profile order within each model; no sorting by performance.
definitions.separate90: The Muse/Nemo Exa comparison is a distinct 90-setting historical rerun. Its data remain separate at the top level of this export.
definitions.exclusions: Strict16, untested Claude settings and cancelled repeat trials are excluded from 260.

qualifications: Family totals pool unequal numbers of reasoning profiles, API/native routes and serving-context/compute conditions. They are descriptive counts for this selected task set, not a controlled leaderboard.
Each task has 26 profile strata, not 26 independent repeat trials of one model.
The original and web runs span different preserved harness implementations and context policies; web availability is not the only changed component.
A pass transition does not identify search causation or training-set membership.
No answer values, task solutions, raw transcripts, private reasoning, job/attempt IDs, file paths or API receipts are included.

excludingCarrierCisMvmrAndSexBias.label: Exclude carrier residual risk, cis-MVMR / LD and population sex bias
excludingCarrierCisMvmrAndSexBias.interpretation: Descriptive task subset only. The primary analysis retains all260 settings; this exclusion does not establish training membership or isolate search causation.

jointlyParseValid.label: Both conditions have official parse-valid final answers
jointlyParseValid.interpretation: Selected on parse-valid finals in both conditions. Censored, malformed and failed-to-return outcomes are absent by construction; this is not a replacement for the primary260-setting outcome comparison or a causal search estimate.
